purpose: Design document defining how the ADR writer is built: a write-adr skill, an isolated adr-writer custom agent, and an adr_exchange.py script, so ADRs are recorded one file per feature.
summary: Overview of the three components: write-adr entry skill, adr-writer agent, adr_exchange.py script
Architecture diagram and responsibilities of each component and write targets
Design decisions: why an agent, why a skill entry, one ADR file per feature, agent writes the body, returns only a verdict
adr_exchange.py design: identifiers, target file resolution, subcommands open/request-path/finish/check, request fields, inputs
Validation rules: argument checks and verdict-to-file-state correspondence checks in finish
Exit codes and output contract (0/1/2, errors array, rejected and insufficient are not errors)
adr-writer agent spec: tools, write boundary, required reading, per-kind review handling
write-adr skill flow: output resolution, content organizing, numbering, request, agent launch, branching, completion
Normative documents to change and use case/sequence design with error flows
Existing components reused and test design: unit, agent role, contract, and evaluation tests
tasks: Writing tests for the ADR writer
Reviewing ADR writer design or implementation
Updating ADR principles, format, and usage documents
